description: Use this when the user asks how many days can I stay in Europe, wants a schengen visa calculator or needs to plan 90 days in 180 days. Finds the maximum consecutive short stay from an entry date and the first entry that supports a requested length. Past stays must be closed and end by entry; up to 60 stays over 1,100 days, years 1900–2100, requested lengths 1–90 days. Does not authorize entry or model bilateral agreements, residence permits, long-stay visas or visa-sticker limits; not legal advice.

entry_date.description: Planned first day in Schengen. Example: 2026-07-01 or July 1, 2026. Past stays must end on or before this day.

past_stays.description: Up to 60 short stays spanning at most 1,100 days. Example: [{"entry_date":"2026-03-05","exit_date":"2026-03-20"}]. Use [] for none. Exclude residence-permit and type D visa days.

entry_date.description: First day in Schengen, inclusive. Example: 2026-03-05 or March 5, 2026.

anyOf.description: Last day in Schengen, inclusive. Example: 2026-03-20. Omit only for an ongoing stay in calculation or reset mode.

planned_length.description: Optional consecutive trip length, including entry and exit, from 1 to 90 days. Example: 30.

name: plan_schengen_trip
